description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes related to Cisco Hotspot APIs, including hotspot device and SSID management.

methods.name: CosaDml_HsSsidGetNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of SSID entries.

methods.name: CosaDml_HsSsidGetEntryByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an SSID entry by index.

methods.name: CosaDml_HsSsidGetCfg
methods.description: Gets configuration for a specific SSID.

methods.name: CosaDml_HsSsidAssoDevGetNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of associated devices for a given SSID.

methods.name: CosaDml_HsSsidAssoDevGetEntryByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an associated device entry by index.

methods.name: CosaDml_HsSsidAssoDevGetCfg
methods.description: Gets configuration for a specific associated device.
